'''This''' individual was a [[Utai/Legends|Utai]] who, sometime before [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], worked for the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency's ground crew. His job was to look after the passengers' luggage.<ref name="toy" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Hasbro]] released an exclusive ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' action figure of this character, simply named "Luggage Attendant", as part of the Star Tours Travel Agency pack.<ref name="toy" />
